brief: Draws a text inside a box made of Unicode line characters, the whole text in one box or each character in its own cell.
detail: Build one with new stzStringBoxed("hello"); Boxed and BoxedChars return the drawing as a text and print nothing, and the text held never changes. The global function StzBoxedString(text) (also BoxedString) is the one-call form of Boxed. Several lines of text give several rows in the box, padded to the longest. BoxedChars draws a single row and its borders are mis-sized today, see its warning.
